review_notes: Article names three members of the Lama family killed when the landslide buried their shelter.
Article reports a mother and her two-year-old daughter died when the landslide hit their house.
Setidobhan landslide blocked both directions of the Narayangadh-Muglin road.
Article explicitly describes a mud/debris-laden slide (ledosahitko pahiro) blocking the highway.
Rock-and-soil landslide at Lower Siddhababa blocked Siddhartha Highway.
Siruwari/Upper Baisari landslide disrupted direct traffic on the Beni-Jomsom road.
Evidence explicitly describes mud-laden landslide debris at Jantipahiro blocking the corridor.
The motorcycle rider struck by the landslide died at the scene.
Later follow-up reports confirm 11 deaths from the Barekot-4 Sarki village landslide, with one still missing.
Charkilo landslide stopped traffic in both directions on the Narayangadh-Muglin road.
Mahabhir landslide obstructed the Beni-Jomsom road and stranded vehicles.
Both reports describe muddy landslide material (ledo mato) covering the road.
Chumang Bhir landslide deposited rock and soil on the Koshi Highway and blocked traffic.
Large Jorte landslide closed the Palpa-Gulmi road and stranded traffic.
All reports confirm the mother and her three-year-old daughter were killed when the house was buried.
Evidence describes a dry landslide containing rock debris that blocked the Ridi-Tamghas road, not a distinct rockfall.
Fisling landslide blocked the Prithvi Highway until debris was cleared.
New dry landslide at Tuin Khola fully blocked the Narayangadh-Muglin road.
Dry landslide near Topekhola blocked both directions of the Narayangadh-Muglin road.
Worker was buried by a construction-site soil collapse during foundation excavation and rescued alive.
A rock falling from the cliff with the slide struck and killed a mother and daughter.
Article explicitly calls the Dalal failure a mudslide and reports that it blocked the Dumre-Besisahar road.
Bhalupahad landslide fully blocked Siddhartha Highway.
Landslide with large rocks blocked the Besisahar-Chame road and stranded vehicles.
One rescued man later died from injuries sustained when the landslide buried his house.
The only occupant was reported injured and receiving treatment; no death occurred in the event.
The buried car's driver and passengers were all reported safe after rescue.
